title: R8: Honest end card: 'You ran' vs 'You made'; qualify the lamps line (S)
description:
Effort: S. Do first.

**Problem.** The end card claims the student made things she did not.
**Evidence.** Lesson 1 'You made: Put 5 in the box' (starter card); lesson 7 'You can make any number this way' with six lamps (max 63).
**Change.** 'You ran' for starter cards, 'You made' only for edited or built cards; qualify the lamps line ('any number up to 63').
**Acceptance.**
- Given an unedited starter card, then the end card says 'You ran'.
- Given an edited or built card, then it says 'You made'.
- Given six lamps, then the claim says up to 63.
right_now_summary: The end card will say “You ran” for starter cards and limit the lamps claim to numbers up to 63.
